steps.learned_between_rounds: Round 1 left picnic and workshop close and showed distance as the main barrier. I drafted and published a follow-up on a combined event and travel limit. Flashpoint then counted the publish as the second email, so the send was refused. I never saw round 2 answers.
steps.limits: Only 6 of 8 answered, so this is a direction and not a measurement. Picnic and workshop are close. The combined event and the travel limit were never asked. Open answers were thin, and one was junk. The 2 non-responders were not reminded.
lessons: Check how the system counts emails before publishing a follow-up. Here the second email was used up before the send, so the follow-up never went out. Ask Flashpoint about the email count first.
Don't seal predictions for a round until the send is confirmed possible. I sealed round 2 and never got to open it.
On a list this small, a ranking question gives split first places and average ranks that disagree. Ask a head-to-head or combined-option question in the first survey.
